lead: A `%2$s` in a *double-quoted* Novis literal is an interpolated `$s`, not a `Core\Str::format` placeholder.
body: Interpolation happens in the lexer, long before the intrinsic pass reads the template, so a positional-placeholder fixture written with double quotes fails as ``E0301 `$s` is not declared`` and pins nothing about `format`. Single-quote any template containing `$` (`'%2$s'`), which is what the cases in `crates/nvs-types/tests/intrinsics.rs` already do.
